proposed_from.topic: For finite ordered SCMs with explicitly listed finite alphabets, unrestricted complete-predecessor functions, and arbitrary shared exogenous variation, prove that the equality partition of h factual/intervention-world complete prefixes is an exact continuation state. Derive representative transitions deciding one explicit unnested conjunction in Bell(h) * 3^((h-1)/3) * poly(input) time and an explicit rational combination of r conjunctions in Bell(h) * 2^r * (r+1)^(h-1) * poly(input) time, with alphabet size absent from the exponential. Reconstruct sparse response rows plus defaults, attain sharp observational cell-sum endpoints with one exogenous atom per positive-mass cell, and preserve joint term dependence. Prove a scoped separation on binary S<T<X1<...<Xn<Y: factual zero, A=do(S=1), B=do(S=1,T=1), and query T_A=0, all X_i,A=0, Y_B=1 leave 2^n accepting numeric B histories after every pin but one partition state per layer. Charge dense input reading and explicit unnesting; exclude sparse prescribed graphs, independence restrictions, cycles, and claims about all reduced MDDs. Credit Halpern's certificate/hardness and Rossetto--Antonucci's cell-sum construction. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Informal proofs establish exact partition continuation, complete representative transitions, both transition bounds, joint truth flags, sparse traceback, false-bit handling, and cellwise attainment. Existing checks passed 119,100 local transitions, 18,486 joint cell problems, 1,200 mixed-alphabet cases, and 192 NDE cases. A fresh independent pass added 1,414 same-partition suffix-support and 1,369 partition-plus-flags truth-support comparisons, including all 32,768 binary four-variable response systems. Actual pinned copid query classes and builds produced three normalized contexts and 2^n accepting pre-Y prefixes for n=1 through 4. Contradictory/repeated terms, empty conjunctions, singleton and exhausted alphabets, cross-block constants, false-bit asymmetry, sparse/dense inputs, structural versus sample zeros, and the prescribed-sparse-graph counterexample were checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: No core theorem implication remains unresolved; the principal risk is an unlocated equality-abstraction specialization with the same causal h-context theorem, followed by production implementation and formal verification. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare complete numeric suffix supports for histories sharing a partition and terminal truth supports for histories sharing partition plus flags across mixed alphabets and query constants; any mismatch kills the quotient, and a literal prior theorem with these bounds forces a novelty pivot. seed_details.title: Exact equality-partition continuation for order-only finite structural causal models
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction, Theorems~1--4, the lifted linear program theorem, the constructive sharpness proof, and its Conclusion. The proof first enumerates complete response signatures and only then quotients them by observational and query evaluations.
seed_details.opportunity: Move the quotient to partial multi-world evaluation: prove that equality of complete prefixes is a right congruence for every later complete-predecessor function, then compile sharp cell labels without enumerating response signatures.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the anchor's completed-signature equivalence classes by an induction on coordinates in which one common natural output is chosen independently for each current equality block.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for finite causal models combined with equality patterns, prefix continuation, Bell-number states, finite-domain uninterpreted functions, coherent uninterpreted programs, and counterfactual knowledge compilation found general equality abstractions but no causal \(h\)-context theorem with alphabet-independent exponential dependence.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Rossetto--Antonucci because their lifted classes already identify observationally and query-equivalent response signatures.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their classes are defined after full response evaluation and retain an alphabet-product bound; they do not prove that a local prefix equality type preserves all continuation supports or yield the stated \(h\)-parameter runtimes.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The result does not relabel the published linear program: its focal object is an exact streaming continuation state with a constructive transition system and an explicit representation separation.

seed_details.title: A causal Myhill--Nerode frontier for world-partition states
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction, Definition~3.1 and the succinctness comparisons, Sections~4--5 on supported queries and transformations, and its Conclusion. Its proof discipline separates representation size from online operations by polynomial translations and distinguishability arguments.
seed_details.anchor_quote: There are three key aspects of any knowledge compilation approach: the succinctness of the target language; the class of queries; and the class of transformations.
seed_details.opportunity: Determine whether all \(\operatorname{Bell}(h)\) partitions are pairwise distinguishable residuals for order-only counterfactual continuation, or construct a uniformly smaller exact quotient.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace propositional-language translations by causal suffix distinguishers that must share one ordered structural system and must distinguish two prefix partitions through later response rows and literals.
seed_details.destination_search: The target--method search combined causal Myhill--Nerode, residual counterfactual language, Bell lower bounds, ordered decision diagrams, and equality types; no pairwise causal residual theorem was located.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from ordinary automaton minimization because partitions are the obvious states of equality logic.
seed_details.rebuttal: State sufficiency does not imply minimality; causal suffixes obey a shared ordered response system, so ordinary arbitrary suffix distinguishers do not transfer.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed asks for both directions of an exact residual characterization rather than presenting the current upper bound as optimal.

seed_details.title: Joint continuation compilation for observational and experimental tables
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction, Theorem~2.4 on finite canonical structural causal models, the polynomial-program construction in Section~3, its attainment argument, and its Conclusion. The construction preserves all supplied regimes by canonical latent response types.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Solving such polynomial programs is in general computationally expensive.
seed_details.opportunity: Find an equality-pattern state that preserves cross-regime latent coupling and gives exact sharp bounds without enumerating the complete canonical response domain.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The one-table proof's private atom for each factual cell fails first: a single response row contributes simultaneously to several regime cells, so the state must retain a coupling signature across table prefixes.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing multi-source counterfactual bounds with quotient automata, equality types, response-row coupling, and symbolic circuits found canonical polynomial programs and approximate causal EM, but no exact alphabet-independent continuation compiler.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by adding one truth flag for every supplied table cell to the single-table compiler.
seed_details.rebuttal: Truth flags record evaluations but not the shared latent mass constraints tying regimes; the cellwise attainment construction ceases to be valid at exactly that step.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed is not merely a larger linear program; the open object is a common-SCM continuation state and a constructive coupling theorem.

seed_details.title: Syntax-directed compilation of nested counterfactual formulas
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction, Theorem~1 on finitary completeness, the small-model normal-form construction, Theorem~2 on \(\mathsf{PSPACE}\), and its Conclusion and Future Work. The normal form enumerates complete intervention-indexed valuations.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Satisfiability and validity for \(\mathcal L_1\), \(\mathcal L_2\), and \(\mathcal L_3\) can be decided in polynomial space.
seed_details.opportunity: Compile bounded-live-world nested Boolean formulas directly, avoiding the explicit disjunctive unnesting used by order-only response-signature bounds.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace full intervention-indexed valuation atoms in the logical normal form by a syntax-directed environment that carries live bindings together with the prefix equality partition.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for nested counterfactual automata, bounded live worlds, direct counterfactual circuits, and equality-partition semantics found logical \(\mathsf{PSPACE}\) bounds and graphical parallel-world merging but no parameterized sharp-bound compiler.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from recursive syntactic unnesting because every nested formula is a finite Boolean combination of unnested worlds.
seed_details.rebuttal: That transformation may materialize exponentially many conjunctions and does not provide a continuation congruence for live substitution bindings.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed's focal object is a direct syntax automaton, not the already published unnesting identity.

seed_details.title: Separator-augmented continuation states for sparse acyclic graphs
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction, Theorem~1 and Corollaries~1--2 on twin-network width, Theorem~2 on separator duplication, the multi-world discussion, and its Conclusion. Its construction transports a base elimination structure to parallel worlds when mechanisms are fixed.
seed_details.anchor_quote: The (causal) treewidth of a twin network is at most twice the (causal) treewidth of its base network plus one.
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the finite boundary information that must augment equality partitions when natural outputs depend only on prescribed sparse parent projections, and seek \(f(h,w)\operatorname{poly}(N)\) sharp-bound evaluation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: The order-only transition proof fails because distinct complete prefixes can induce the same sparse parent tuple; the first replacement is a separator-indexed equivalence on the parent projections exposed at the current bag.
seed_details.destination_search: The target--method search joined response-function uncertainty with multi-world treewidth, causal treewidth, credal polytrees, and separator states. Han--Chen--Darwiche cover fixed mechanisms, while Zaffalon et al. prove hardness for partially specified polytrees; no necessary-and-sufficient boundary state was located.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by running ordinary junction-tree inference on the \(h\)-world network.
seed_details.rebuttal: Junction-tree inference presupposes fixed factors; sharp partial identification quantifies over unknown response functions and must preserve which sparse parent calls are forced equal across worlds.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed explicitly confronts the prescribed-sparse-graph counterexample and the polytree hardness boundary.

seed_details.title: Orbit continuation under districtwise exogenous factorization
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor's Introduction, Theorem~2.4, canonical c-component construction, polynomial constraints, proof appendix, and Conclusion were opened. Its first departure from the shared-exogenous linear program is the product factorization across latent districts.
seed_details.anchor_quote: Solving such polynomial programs is in general computationally expensive.
seed_details.opportunity: Construct a factor-aware orbit state whose size is controlled by worlds and district width rather than by endogenous alphabet cardinalities.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace cellwise arbitrary mixing by a tensor-compatible continuation invariant because district independence introduces multiplicative constraints across response rows.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for factorized response-type quotients, district orbits, symmetric polynomial programs, and credal causal compilation found canonical polynomial programs and credal mappings but no alphabet-independent exact orbit quotient.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate by applying the prefix compiler independently inside each latent district.
seed_details.rebuttal: Independent local feasibility does not preserve the polynomial product constraints that determine a common observational law and sharp counterfactual endpoint.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The proposal would need a new tensor or orbit theorem, so it is not padded as an easy extension of the shared-exogenous case.

seed_details.title: Fixed-parameter causal satisfiability by simultaneous live worlds
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at its Introduction and parameterized-complexity map, Theorem~9 on binary causal-linear hardness, Theorem~11 on fixed-parameter tractability by variable count plus range size, its model-enumeration proof, and Concluding Remarks.
seed_details.anchor_quote: The presented findings open up several avenues for future work.
seed_details.opportunity: Replace endogenous-variable count plus range size by the number of explicit intervention contexts for conjunction or rational-score satisfiability over an ordered complete-predecessor model.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace enumeration of all structural functions \(Q_1\times\cdots\times Q_k\) by coordinatewise representative transitions on live-world equality partitions.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing causal satisfiability with intervention-context number, live worlds, Bell states, and domain-independent parameterization found only variable-count or graph-width parameterizations.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Ganian--Gruendel--Wietheger because their fixed-parameter algorithm already enumerates a finite canonical model.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their parameter includes both the number of endogenous variables and the maximum range; the desired exponent is independent of both when the live-world count is fixed.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed names a distinct parameterized frontier rather than claiming a new classical complexity class.

seed_details.title: Uniform inference for compiled order-only sharp endpoints
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor's Introduction, exact-bound theorem, lifted linear program, empirical examples, and Conclusion were opened. It supplies identification and attainment but no uniform endpoint inference theorem.
seed_details.opportunity: Use compiled cell labels to characterize regular and degenerate laws and construct finite-sample or uniformly valid confidence regions for sharp endpoint pairs without enumerating response signatures.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After compiling the fixed cell labels, replace ordinary nonregular linear-program inference by a multinomial mean problem; the unresolved step is scalable exact projection when unobserved cells retain positive candidate mass.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for inference on counterfactual-bound linear programs, directionally differentiable endpoints, and exact multinomial projection found general directional-delta and intersection-bound methods but no compiler-aware finite-sample projection with the stated complexity.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the sample-mean central limit theorem because compiled lower and upper cell labels are fixed.
seed_details.rebuttal: Pointwise asymptotic normality is immediate and is not the seed; scalable uniform or exact projection over candidate multinomial laws remains the nontrivial object.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The standard sample-mean corollary is explicitly excluded from the novelty claim.

seed_details.title: Avoiding enumeration of linear extensions of a query-induced partial order
seed_details.anchor_read: The anchor was opened at Theorem~4 on invariance across compatible total orders and its proof, in addition to the Introduction and Conclusion.
seed_details.opportunity: Compile directly on a partial order without enumerating its linear extensions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Attempt to replace a chosen total order by an antichain transition.
seed_details.destination_search: The anchor's order-invariance theorem already makes any single compatible total order sufficient for the same bound.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Rossetto--Antonucci's order-invariance theorem because one arbitrary linear extension already yields the sharp value.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for the proposed value-computation target; a partial-order implementation alone would be engineering rather than a new theorem.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: Rejected as already settled rather than padded into the candidate pool.
